official_API.scope: ID.library identifies the linked library; ID.library_weak_reference describes append-reuse metadata. Classification of a local observed weak property as stored provenance is a rule inferred from that documented purpose, not a proof of complete dependency closure.
The typed descriptor carries library filepath and full target ID name. Exact observed5.1 descriptor metadata remains the actual evidence; the5.4 page does not qualify5.1 behavior.
Library represents an external blend file from which data is linked. The defensive typed Library fixture does not weaken the old survey's linked-library refusal.

Image source distinguishes FILE and VIEWER; type distinguishes IMAGE, RENDER_RESULT and COMPOSITING; filepath and filepath_raw are metadata; packed_files records packing. These labels alone do not prove export use, existence or complete internal ownership.

SpaceImageEditor.image is the image displayed/edited by that space. Saved exact UI witnesses come from the authenticated94feb collector's explicit IMAGE_EDITOR type/image check. An optional unavailable human-readable RNA path does not erase that observation.

file_path_foreach supplies owning ID, raw path and reserved argument; None does not replace a path. The unchanged collector omits SKIP_WEAK_REFERENCES and retains SKIP_PACKED. The classifier itself invokes no Blender API.

installed_public_source_read_only.scope: Confirms ID-to-users user_map direction and traversal cycle handling. Does not establish complete UI/implicit-producer scope or native allocation bounds.
